//overrides: next pins postcss to an exact 8.4.31 and sharp to ^0.34.3, and both ranges are
vulnerable with no forward fix at ANY next version (the advisories cover next through
16.3.0-preview.7). Both are build-only here — output:'export' ships static files from
caddy:2-alpine, and images.unoptimized disables the sharp path entirely — so the CVEs
are not reachable in production. Resolved rather than allowlisted anyway: a real
upgrade keeps `npm audit` meaningful, and a green audit is the only kind anyone reads.
Both are same-major/compatible bumps and `npm run build` is verified against them.
